reason: The basics stay free, so I'm not mad. I'd pay for the cute stuff: new pets, a room, widgets. One-time $6.99 is like a skin in a game, and I already pay for cosmetics in Finch.
objection: I have three to-do apps I never use. I might pay and then stop opening it, and the cosmetics would be wasted.
would_change_my_mind: If the free app ever started locking core things like the timer or brain dump, I'd delete it and not buy. Seeing real previews of the pets and the room before paying would make me more sure.
